items.title: Carnival’s CFO on Restoring the Company’s Balance Sheet After the Pandemic
items.summary: At Carnival, CFO David Bernstein made a commitment to investors: He wouldn’t leave until the company repaid its pandemic-era debt.  Now, nearly five years after the cruise operator’s first ship returned to sea, Bernstein said he and other Carnival insiders have delivered.  Having kept his word, the CFO plans to stay put.

items.title: Is Carnival (CCL) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Carnival (CCL) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?
